name: CreateWorkItemNode
label: Create Work Item
description: Creates a new work item in the specified queue.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: QueueName
fields.label: Select Queue
fields.description: Choose the queue in which to create the work item.

fields.name: Description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional description for the work item.

fields.name: SourceWorkItemId
fields.label: Source Work Item ID
fields.description: Optional source work item identifier for the work item. Leave empty to generate a new work item id; provide an existing source work item id (SourceWorkItemId) to schedule a retry (a new attempt is created for it).

fields.name: WorkItemData
fields.label: Work Item Data
fields.description: Provide the data for the work item in JSON format.

fields.name: RetryTime
fields.label: Retry Time
fields.description: Optional future date and time after which this work item becomes eligible for processing. Leave empty for immediate processing. Text value in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-09-12T14:30:00Z).

fields.name: FileUrls
fields.label: File URLs
fields.description: Optional URLs of files associated with the work item, separated by commas.
